features.name: Value-led teen retention across Room, History, Circle, Bridge, and Bip Energy
acceptanceCriteria: Meaningful teen actions create privacy-safe return receipts and the canonical Room offers expression, regulation, or chosen-connection next steps.
History emphasizes active days and meaningful actions while streak bonuses remain positive and absence does not erase the teen's growth record.
Public Circle support reactions remain usable while aggregate totals are returned only to the post owner and cannot be downloaded through direct client table SELECT access.
Bridge persists the teen's requested response and the linked parent can see that request without gaining access to journals, chats, mood history, voice notes, or other private content.

Bip Energy keeps the intentional one-day grace, once-per-day, maximum-five, never-below-zero fade against the canonical bip_events ledger while Bip Tickets, redeemed rewards, and unlocked room items remain permanent.

rollout.controlKey: BipReturnOverlay on the canonical teen Room with route-level History, Circle, and Bridge integration

verification.blocker: Exact-head CI, Type Check, Quality Gate, Regression, Pre-Push, Playwright, physical-device layout/accessibility QA, controlled two-account Bridge response-request proof, and controlled two-account Circle owner-only total proof remain before verified or released status.

features.rollback: Revert the feature merge and apply reviewed follow-up migrations to restore prior RPC, trigger, and Circle table-grant definitions if needed. Keep additive event rows and the nullable response_preference column unless a separate data-safe removal is reviewed.
